~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ fw1-ctx FW context ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### VRF START ########### 
changeto context system
config terminal
!
!
interface Port-channel{int_#}.{Vlan_ID_vrfglue}
  vlan {Vlan_ID_vrfglue}
  no shut
!
context {FW_context_name}
  allocate-interface Port-channel{int_#}.{Vlan_ID_vrfglue} visible
!
end
!
!copy running startup
!
changeto context {FW_context_name}
config terminal
!
!
interface Port-channel{int_#}.{Vlan_ID_vrfglue}
  nameif {VRF_name}
  security-level 50
  ip address {Vrfglue_prefix_1st_IP} {Vrfglue_prefix_netmask} standby {{Vrfglue_prefix_1st_IP}+1}
!
object-group network VRF_{VRF_name}_Subnets
  network-object {Vrfglue_prefix} {Vrfglue_prefix_netmask}
!
object-group network All_VRF_Subnets
  group-object VRF_{VRF_name}_Subnets
!
access-list {VRF_name}_access_in extended permit ip {Vrfglue_prefix} {Vrfglue_prefix_netmask} any
!
access-group {VRF_name}_access_in in interface {VRF_name}
!
mtu {VRF_name} 8500
!
!
ip verify reverse-path interface {VRF_name}
!
monitor-interface {VRF_name}
!
icmp permit any {VRF_name}
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### VRF END ############# 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site01-hub1 ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### VRF START ########### 
!
ip vrf {VRF_name}
  rd 64000:{RD_#}
  route-target export 64000:{RD_#}
  route-target import 64000:{RD_#}
!
vlan {Vlan_ID_vrfglue}
  name {FW_context_name}-VRFGLUE={VRF_name}
!
interface Port-channel1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_vrfglue}
!
Interface Port-channel{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_vrfglue}
!
interface vlan{Vlan_ID_vrfglue}
  description {FW_context_name}-VRFGLUE={VRF_name}
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding {VRF_name}
  ip address {{Vrfglue_prefix_last_IP}-1} {Vrfglue_prefix_netmask}
  standby ip {Vrfglue_prefix_last_IP} 
  standby preempt
  standby priority 105
  standby authentication md5 key-string 0 {key_word}
  no shutdown
!
router bgp 64000
  address-family ipv4 vrf {VRF_name}
    redistribute connected
    redistribute static
    no synchronization
        network 0.0.0.0
        exit-address-family
!
ip route {Vrfglue_prefix} {Vrfglue_prefix_netmask} {GW-FW_outside_IP} name {FW_context_name}:{FW_context_name}-VRFGLUE={VRF_name}
!
ip route vrf {VRF_name} 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 {Vrfglue_prefix_1st_IP} name {FW_context_name}:DEFAULT-ROUTE={VRF_name}
!
!copy running start
!
! ########### VRF END ############# 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site02-hub1 FW context router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### VRF START ########### 
!
ip vrf {VRF_name}
  rd 64000:{RD_#}
  route-target export 64000:{RD_#}
  route-target import 64000:{RD_#}
!
vlan {Vlan_ID_vrfglue}
  name {FW_context_name}-VRFGLUE={VRF_name}
!
interface Port-channel1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_vrfglue}
!
Interface Port-channel{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_vrfglue}
!
interface vlan{Vlan_ID_vrfglue}
  description {FW_context_name}-VRFGLUE={VRF_name}
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding {VRF_name}
  ip address {{Vrfglue_prefix_last_IP}-2} {Vrfglue_prefix_netmask}
  standby ip {Vrfglue_prefix_last_IP} 
  standby preempt
  standby priority 100
  standby authentication md5 key-string 0 {key_word}
  no shutdown
!
router bgp 64000
  address-family ipv4 vrf {VRF_name}
    redistribute connected
    redistribute static
    no synchronization
        network 0.0.0.0
        exit-address-family
!
ip route {Vrfglue_prefix} {Vrfglue_prefix_netmask} {GW-FW_outside_IP} name {FW_context_name}-VRFGLUE={VRF_name}
!
ip route vrf {VRF_name} 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 {Vrfglue_prefix_1st_IP} name {FW_context_name}:DEFAULT-ROUTE={VRF_name}
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### VRF END #############
